svg.text: Wireframe-style storyboard panels + short text descriptions beneath each user story.

g.text: Description: User schedules a morning ride with a clearly-labeled “Guaranteed pickup” option.
The flow emphasizes reliability (tight window, assignment timing, reminders) to reduce late-to-work anxiety.
Description: The app shows a full, honest fare estimate (including fees) before booking.
A “price lock” message and a single “Book for $X.XX” CTA reinforce predictable budgeting.
Description: Users can browse simple commuter ride packs and see savings in plain terms.
At checkout, the best applicable discount applies automatically, showing “you saved $X” for trust.
US09 — Track Driver Arrival in Real Time
Panel 1 — Ride booked, waiting at home
Description: Real-time tracking updates ETA continuously and triggers an “Approaching” alert.
A clear “Leave now” moment helps the rider step out at the right time without waiting outside.
Panel 1 — Enable backup option during booking
Description: Riders can opt into an automatic backup ride if a driver cancels.
If cancellation occurs, the system re-dispatches immediately and confirms a replacement with a revised ETA and stable pricing.

svg.text: Tip: Save this as “ux_storyboards_us06-us10.svg” and open in any browser or design tool.
